summary: Frontend-only validation of swipe-to-next-AHU + keyboard nav feature in /app/frontend/public/mobile_mockup.html. All 6 phases from the review request pass: keyboard ArrowRight/Left nav, cyclic wrap-around (AHU-01 ←→ AHU-05), synthetic touch swipe nav, home-page inertness, modal/dropdown isolation, and subtitle visual hint. Regression spot-check on /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 React redirect also passes.

test_evidence.phase1_keyboard_nav: PASS — ArrowRight from AHU-01 → AHU-02 (hash=#/ahu/AHU-02); ArrowLeft → AHU-01; worst-first sorted order discovered = [AHU-01, AHU-02, AHU-03, AHU-04, AHU-05]; ArrowLeft from AHU-01 wraps to AHU-05; ArrowRight from AHU-05 wraps back to AHU-01.
test_evidence.phase2_touch_swipe: PASS — synthetic TouchEvent (touchstart 300,400 → touchend 100,405) drove AHU-01 → AHU-02. Reverse swipe (100→300) returned to AHU-01.
test_evidence.phase3_home_inert: PASS — On /mobile_mockup.html (no hash), data-view='home', ArrowRight is a no-op; .ahu-id is null and hash stays empty.
test_evidence.phase4_modal_dropdown_isolation: PASS — With #ddTrigger dropdown open, ArrowRight still navigates AHU-01 → AHU-02 (keyboard is only gated by data-view). With #ahuModal open, a left-swipe whose touchstart originated inside the modal did NOT trigger AHU nav (.ahu-id stayed AHU-01).
test_evidence.phase5_subtitle_hint: PASS — `.subtitle` text contains literal 'swipe ← → for next AHU' on AHU detail page.
test_evidence.phase6_regression: PASS — /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 React route redirects to /mobile_mockup.html#/ahu/AHU-01 and renders AHU-01 with data-view='ahu'.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: `window.AHUs` is not exposed (it's a module-scoped `let` at line 235). The review request's instructions assumed `window.AHUs` would be readable from devtools; not a functional bug, but consider `window.AHUs = AHUs` after each rebuild for easier external inspection/testing.
The 220ms outgoing transition + 200ms setTimeout before hash change in setupSwipeNav.go() creates a brief visual gap on slower devices; works fine on preview but worth noting.
touchstart handler ignores targets inside `.dropdown`, but keyboard handler intentionally does not — this matches the spec (only data-view gating for keys). Verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Worst-first sort order on this preview (with current live data) is [AHU-01, AHU-02, AHU-03, AHU-04, AHU-05]. Therefore wrap-around for ArrowLeft from AHU-01 lands on AHU-05, and ArrowRight from AHU-05 lands on AHU-01. AHUs variable is not on window — use the cycling-by-ArrowRight pattern in test scripts to enumerate. networkidle waits time out on this page (long-poll websocket), so use wait_until='load' with goto.
